identity.name: E1_Neon_Brutalism
identity.vibe: The Terminal of Truth. Futuristic, decisive, uncomfortably clear.
principles: Emotion: Validation is scary but necessary. Design should feel like a cockpit.
Content: Data over decoration. If it doesn't help the founder decide, kill it.
Contrast: High contrast is mandatory. No low-contrast grey text.

mono.usage: Data points, scores, code snippets, 'thinking' logs.

usage_rules.gradients: Use sparingly. Only for 'magical' AI moments, not for generic buttons.
usage_rules.text: Headings are white. Body is slate-300. Never use pure grey (#808080).

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Asymmetrical). Never use equal 3-column grids for features.
layout.spacing: Generous. Minimum p-8 for sections. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.
layout.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Use 'Tracing Beam' effect for active cards.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.

steps: 1. Setup Tailwind config with new colors and fonts.
3. Create 'Layout' component with Navbar and Footer.
4. Build 'Hero' section with Bento Grid and 3D/Abstract background.
5. Build 'Chat' interface with 'Typewriter' effect for AI responses.
6. Build 'Results' page with Recharts (customized to look like a HUD).
anti_patterns: Do NOT use purple/teal gradients for buttons.
Do NOT center everything. Use asymmetry.
Do NOT use default Shadcn cards without customization.

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios. Use aria-labels for icon buttons.
universal_guidelines.code_style: Functional components. Named exports for components, default for pages.
